semantics_notes: official_id is the exact source ID; base_form_id is suffix after first digit and is an observed grouping convention, not a documented API contract.
Chess rows include star levels, transformed forms and summons. Do not treat all as separately purchasable heroes.
shows_in_official_gallery is display metadata, not a proven shop availability or unlock rule.
effect_numeric_tokens and effect_keyword_tags are retrieval hints, not executable rules. Fetch official source for exact mechanics.
Official public resource URLs are observed frontend assets, not a promised/stable third-party API.
Source files have different generation timestamps. This is not a single patch-time snapshot or a verified live-client ruleset.
Announcement patch 18.6 differs from internal configuration version 18.18.1; never compare them as the same version numbering system.
Empty source data means no records observed in that file, not a proof the gameplay feature does not exist.
